headlines.label: Group PO value, last 12 months
headlines.sentence: Confirmed customer orders were S$55.7M in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, +4.9% on the year before, counted on de-duplicated customers.

headlines.label: Forecast error, today's method vs ours (A+B)
headlines.sentence: Today's rolling average is off by 15 units per 100 ordered; our seasonal model is off by 12 (backtested on 6 months it never saw).

headlines.label: Duplicate customer records found
headlines.sentence: 17 of 301 customer records are duplicates; merging them, and re-coding two records to the right country, moves S$1.04M of orders back to MY and VN.

headlines.label: Setup time for a new record
headlines.sentence: Amy's item took 18 days; with one form, parallel approvals in Teams and a 2-day SLA the target median is 4 business days or less.

headlines.label: Phase-1 payback
headlines.sentence: Phase 1 costs about S$39.9k with no new licences and releases ~1,751 hours a year (≈0.94 FTE), paying back in about 6 months at 80 requests a month.
